slots.notes: Functional UI glyphs from lucide-react (Menu and X for the animated mobile hamburger toggle, ArrowRight size-15 inside the hero CTA that translates right 0.5 on hover). Single-color stroke icons that inherit currentColor; a reskin can swap the icon set wholesale.

The primary brand typeface used for the wordmark, nav links, hero headline and all CTA labels via Inter (weights 400/500/600/700, loaded from Google Fonts with -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased + -moz-osx-font-smoothing:grayscale globally). Headline renders at clamp(1.75rem,5vw,2.6rem) with leading-[1.12] and tight tracking, so the substitute must hold up at large near-tight settings.

mechanic: Single full-viewport dark hero where a layered real-time WebGL shader stack (studio lighting + oklab swirl + lens flare + floating particles + cursor ripples + film grain, spherized) renders behind a centered Inter headline, a monospace subtext and a pill CTA, with a liquid-glass nav pill on top and an Escape-dismissable staggered slide-down mobile menu.
techDelivery: React + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS + Vite + lucide-react, with the background rendered by the `shaders` npm package (`shaders/react`, v2.5.124+); Inter loaded from Google Fonts; the liquid-glass pill is a custom Tailwind `@layer components` rule.
reskinNotes:
The signature background is generative, not an asset — there is no video or image to bind; reskinning its look means editing ~20 hardcoded hex literals baked directly into the JSX props (StudioBackground backColor #1a0f2e / color #17171c / fillColor + keyColor #ffffff, Swirl colorA #0a0a0d + colorB #0f0f1a in oklab, Spherize lightColor #a9cbe8, FloatingParticles particleColor #c5b7ed), none of which are tokenized. The liquid-glass nav pill's border-gradient is a hardcoded white-alpha linear-gradient (rgba(255,255,255,0.45->0.15->0->0.15->0.45)) plus inset box-shadow in CSS, and the mobile menu background rgba(8,8,8,0.97) and stagger easing cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1) are literal. All copy is hardcoded in markup, with the headline carrying a mobile-hidden inline
(two-line desktop break) and the monospace subtext a second
, so per-line breaks live in the JSX. The headline size is a font-metric-dependent clamp(1.75rem,5vw,2.6rem) and the wordmark/nav are white text on the shader (no logo file), so a wider substitute font or longer brand name shifts the centered layout.
